# AI Services

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

AI Services are a suite of intelligence APIs for common AI workloads. You can use these APIs to process media data and create customized solutions. AI Services are part of the [Zoom Build platform](/docs/build/).

This documentation covers API concepts, authentication, processing modes, and endpoint references for each AI service to help you integrate these capabilities into your applications.

To quickly get started, visit **[Zoom.ai](https://zoom.ai/)** to explore pricing plans, try interactive demos, and set up your account.

## Scribe API

[Scribe API](/docs/ai-services/scribe/) provides speech-to-text transcription for audio. It supports real-time (Live mode), fast synchronous (Fast mode), and large-scale batch (Batch mode) transcript processing.

### Key features

-   **Large-scale processing**

    Transcribes up to 10,000 audio files in a single job, or 1,000 files from a manifest

-   **Smart formatting**

    Automatically adds timestamps, punctuation, and speaker separation

-   **Common audio formats**

    Transcribes WAV, M4A, MP3, MP4, and WebM files

-   **Speech understanding**

    Supports multilingual recognition, language detection, custom vocabulary, Text Polishing, and labeling each transcript item with the participant or source that spoke it

## Summarizer API

[Summarizer API](/docs/ai-services/summarizer/) offers conversation and meeting summarization for transcripts from any system. It supports fast synchronous summarization and large-scale batch processing.
